title: The two foxes
summary: Below the Black Stone Cave, Zhang Xiaofan tells the Six-Tailed Fox he has come to kill him for harming the villagers. The fox answers that greedy humans woke the beast in the cave, and that the foxes have been holding it back. Shi Tou fights the beast with his Aura Breaker. The Six-Tailed Fox is dying of Jiuhan Ice poison that ruined nearly 1,000 years of training. With Fen Xiang Valley closing in after 300 years, he begs the Three-Tailed Fox to escape, but she refuses to leave him and gives her life. He asks for her song once more, gives Xiaofan the Red Fire Mirror and tells him to keep it hidden, and the two foxes die together. When Li Xun asks, Xiaofan says he did not see the mirror. Yan Hong tells him Qingyun is meeting the other righteous sects at Liubo Mountain in the East Sea, and Xiaofan, Shi Tou and Bi Yao head back to tell the village the foxes are dead.
